metric.description: For each of the 103 crystals, compute 2*abs(prediction-reference)/(prediction+reference), assigning zero when both conductivities are zero. The primary metric is the arithmetic mean over all 103 crystals; lower is better. A valid submission reaches the breakthrough target when its unrounded mean_sre is at most 2/3. This author-set target defines the 1000-point display anchor. An all-zero prediction gives mean_sre = 2 and defines the 0-point anchor.
